state.notes: The actor and source request ID passed to the aggregate are ordinary supplied arguments. The trusted caller must separately verify the request source and principal. Portia expected-position append handles competing stream writers.

exact_retry.instructions: Given one existing metadata fact, does calling Record with the exact same business payload return success without raising another fact?

changed_source.instructions: After one metadata fact, can the same operation with a different edition request event ID be accepted as an exact retry?

changed_note.instructions: After one metadata fact, can a changed coverage note under the same operation be accepted as an exact retry?

different_op.instructions: After one metadata fact, can a different operation ID record another metadata fact on this owner?

empty_source.instructions: Can Record accept an empty edition request event ID?

bad_hash.instructions: Can Record accept a non-lowercase or non-64-character hexadecimal seed fingerprint?

foreign_replay.instructions: Can Apply accept a metadata fact whose edition ID differs from the aggregate edition ID?

duplicate_replay.instructions: Can Apply accept a second metadata fact after one was already applied?

forged_source.instructions: Does the aggregate itself read and verify that a nonempty edition request event ID is a real committed seed request?

actor_proves_system.instructions: Does a nonempty ActorAttribution subject and issuer, by itself, prove the caller is a trusted system principal?

full_coverage.instructions: Does recording one metadata fact prove that every seed entry and support disclosure exists in durable source?

separate_disclosures.instructions: Does the metadata event carry a collection of support disclosures or criteria entries?
